intent: Per kuhy (2026-09-18: 'I do not want it to work like this, I want it to just work normally'): drop the desktop notification and the 5-minute retry loop added earlier today. PS4 mode (046D:C260) cannot be supported on this PC at all (no kernel driver, SDL lg4ff has no c260 either, so FFB is dead too) and the selector is physical; the switch is now on PS3, where the fix attaches by itself at enumeration.
scope: linux_configuration/fixes/g29_wheel_mode.sh: g29_notify_desktop, G29_RUN_USER_DIR and G29_NOTIFY_ID removed; mode detection kept
linux_configuration/fixes/fix_g29_shifter.sh: --ensure in PS4/compat mode still exits 1 naming the mode, no notification
changes: The failure in PS4 mode stays visible in the journal and systemctl --failed with the mode named, which is what was missing on the 2026-09-15/17 boots; nothing nags.
The test notification fired at 10:42 from root never appeared on kuhy's screen anyway; not debugged because the feature is gone.

verification.evidence: systemctl cat g29-shifter-bpf.service has no Restart/StartLimit lines; --status: wheel mode: native, attached now: yes, safety net: enabled

risks: A future PS4-mode boot is silent again except for a failed unit in the journal / systemctl --failed / --status
rollback: git revert, re-run fix_g29_shifter.sh to reinstall the unit
